messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Stay within this direction: Continuous nonlinear optimization over point coordinates via sequential convex programming

Propose ONE conjecture in response, within that direction.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "Solving a sequence of convex programs where each iteration maximizes a lower bound on minimum triangle area via a first-order Taylor approximation of the area determinant around the current point configuration converges to a configuration whose minimum triangle area equals 1/132, achieved by a perturbed triangular lattice where 13 points occupy near-optimal positions along three interleaved hexagonal sublattices. The optimal configuration breaks the full symmetry of the triangular lattice by shifting one sublattice to equalize the two competing smallest-area triangle classes, yielding a minimum area strictly exceeding the 1/144 achieved by the unperturbed 3×3 triangular grid plus boundary points."}
